title: Art Liberation DAO
tagline: Art Liberation DAO was launched to rethink about new business models, NFTs and Web3 native, to empower art creators in general.
description:
Implementing the same existing business models from last century on web3, just because of it's transparency and enforcement, has fallen short on the outcome change that digital content creators and artists need.
Art Liberation DAO was born to rethink the business models with a white board baseline.
how_its_made:
We experimented with FVM, Bacalhao, and Web3/NFT.storage to think about our media registration protocol, but we figured that it was too big to fit the hackathon timeline.
We think that this registration protocol will be needed in the future, and when we finish the right design for it, we might use those technologies to build it.
